# Evaluation on synthetic documents

**Scope.** 24 clearly synthetic, template-generated documents for 6 fictional applicants
(`samples/manifest.json`): 6 Aadhaar, 6 PAN, 6 salary slips, 6 bank statements. Applicant 5's salary slip
deliberately carries a different name (expected MISMATCH). Each document exists in its listed format
(text PDF / PNG / JPEG / scanned PDF) and as a text-layer PDF copy (`samples/text_pdf/`).

**These numbers describe synthetic templates, not real-world performance.** The documents were generated by the
same project that parses them, layouts are clean, and there is no handwriting, glare, photocopy noise or
regional script. Real scans will perform worse.

**Provider used:** `scripted-test-double`, the scripted **test double**. It reads the masked text with label rules,
so these runs measure local text extraction, masking, the privacy gate, output validation and the matching rules,
**not Gemini**. To measure Gemini, run `scripts/evaluate.py --provider gemini` with an API key (sends masked
synthetic text only). That run has **not** been performed for this report.

## Text-layer PDF set (`--set text_pdf`)

Evaluated: 24 of 24 documents.

| Metric | Correct / total |
|---|---|
| Document type | 24 / 24 |
| date_of_birth | 12 / 12 |
| employer_name | 6 / 6 |
| full_name | 24 / 24 |
| gross_salary | 6 / 6 |
| id_number | 12 / 12 |
| net_salary | 6 / 6 |
| pay_period | 6 / 6 |
| Name rules (PAN vs Aadhaar, salary slip vs Aadhaar) | 12 / 12 |

Field accuracy compares normalised names, whitespace-insensitive identifiers/dates, exact decimal amounts and
(month, year) pay periods with the manifest. Fields count only where the document type has them.

## Mixed-format set (`--set mixed`)

Evaluated: 6 of 24. The other 18 documents
(PNG, JPEG and scanned PDF) were **not evaluated** because Tesseract was not installed on the machine that
produced this report: OCR_UNAVAILABLE (Tesseract not installed). Rule accuracy is only
scored for applicants whose documents were all evaluated, so it is 0 / 0 here.

| Metric | Correct / total |
|---|---|
| Document type | 6 / 6 |
| date_of_birth | 3 / 3 |
| employer_name | 1 / 1 |
| full_name | 6 / 6 |
| gross_salary | 1 / 1 |
| id_number | 3 / 3 |
| net_salary | 1 / 1 |
| pay_period | 1 / 1 |

Re-run on a machine with Tesseract to obtain OCR-path figures. The raw outputs are in
`docs/EVALUATION_RESULTS_text_pdf.json` and `docs/EVALUATION_RESULTS_mixed.json`.
